en-US.description: A lightweight, offline utility to batch convert XML files to CSV format. It features a simple interface, supports large datasets, and ensures your private data never leaves your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft XML to CSV Converter is a dedicated software tool designed to effortlessly convert XML (Extensible Markup Language) files into CSV (Comma-Separated Values), XLS and XLSX formats.

XML files are excellent for storing structured data, but they can be difficult to read, edit, or analyze in tools like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or LibreOffice Calc. This software bridges that gap by transforming hierarchical XML data into flat, tabular CSV or Excel sheets that are simple to view, share, and manipulate.

In addition to CSV output, the program can convert XML files into native Excel formats. Whether you're preparing reports, analyzing logs, or importing structured data into business workflows, the XLS/XLSX export ensures full compatibility with Excel.

Unlike online converters that require uploading sensitive or confidential XML data to remote servers, this tool works offline on your computer. Your private information—financial records, customer databases, product inventories, medical data, and more—never leaves your device.

Need to convert dozens or even hundreds of XML files? Simply drag and drop multiple files or folders. The software automatically parses the XML structure and maps it to CSV or Excel columns, saving you hours of manual formatting or scripting.

* XML to CSV
* XML to XLS
* XML to XLSX

Key Features:
* Offline & Secure: No internet connection required; files are converted locally.
* Batch Conversion: Convert thousands of XML files in a single click.
* Drag & Drop Support: Easily add files or folders to the processing queue.
* Flexible Delimiters: Choose your preferred CSV delimiter (comma, semicolon, etc.).
* Smart Parsing: Automatically detects tags and attributes to create structured columns.
* Lightweight: Minimal system resource usage and fast installation.
* Portable Edition: Available as a portable application (no installation required).
* Unicode Support: Fully supports UTF-8 encoding for special characters and non-English languages.
en-US.name: Vovsoft XML to CSV Converter
